verdict.rationale: Yapily documents generating client libraries from an OpenAPI spec for Java, Python, Node.js, etc., which supports the 'official SDK' story, but this is code generation rather than a maintained, first-party SDK repository, and the probe found no accessible OpenAPI spec file, undermining confidence in this claim. missing for 10: evidence of actual published/maintained SDK repos (GitHub links, versioning, install instructions), independent corroboration, and working OpenAPI spec access.
